name: [WINDOW TINT] Car Driving Ultimate
desc:
New Update:
-Optimization Fixed

Welcome to Car Driving Ultimate, where you can explore a large map with an incredible variety of 120 cars, customize them to your liking, and compete against other players! Test your driving skills and enjoy a great driving experience!
Support the game by liking it to receive more updates and join us on social media!

Controls:
-W, A, S, D: Move the car
-Q, E: Up and Down
-M: Automatic/Semi-Automatic Transmission
-P: Handbrake
-V: Camera -B: Camera Lock
-T: Traction Control
-Shift + P: Free Camera
